manifest.sampler: TwoCopyTempering: exact cold Born marginal, blocked Gibbs; differs from draft power ladder
manifest.optimizer: Fresh Adam .001, cap1; moments/sampler persist across release
manifest.scope: First-disorder first-seed L6 diagnostic, no ground-state qualification

bank.rng_policy: Independent restart coordinates in one fixed vectorized random stream; shared sweep permutations.
